facts.fact: Ledges 离此三十多英里且没有直达路，Simon 估计要开掉大半个上午才能到。
facts.anchor: Simon guessed it would take us most of the morning to get there

facts.fact: Simon 在两侧是树篱与新翻田地的乡间窄路上开了近三个小时，途中加过一次油、为一条挡路的母牛停过一次车，还频频停车看地图。
facts.anchor: Simon drove for nearly three hours, puttering along narrow winding lanes bordered by hedgerows and recently plowed fields

facts.fact: Tamsin 在颠簸里睡着了，头枕旧羊毛外套，看起来孩子气又茫然——“我”想到她从没离开 Zennor 这么远。
facts.anchor: She looked childlike, and lost. She’s never been this far from Zennor, I thought

facts.fact: Simon 替“我”把身世故事编派妥当：对外可说父亲是知名演员、亡母是爱尔兰贵族，而 Tamsin 尽可被当成低地国家来的王室访客。
facts.anchor: Your father’s a well-known actor and your late mother was an Irish aristocrat. For all they know, Tamsin is visiting royalty from the Low Countries

facts.fact: Simon 说 Rex 根本不会在意她们的来历：他平素就与合唱队女郎和贵族小姐们来往，在他眼里大家都一样。
facts.anchor: He steps out with chorus girls and the daughters of peers. You’re all the same to him

facts.fact: Simon 讲起 Teddie 最近一场舞会：他不知怎么摸进动物园后门（多半买通了守夜人），还有人带了手提留声机去。
facts.anchor: he somehow found a back gate into the zoo—probably he bribed the night watchman. Someone brought a portable gramophone

facts.fact: 大门铁艺上那不是鸟，是一对狮鹫；顶端蜿蜒的字母拼出 DE VOIL。
facts.anchor: No, not birds—a pair of griffins. Sinuous letters at the top spelled out DE VOIL

facts.fact: 下车时一名穿制服的仆人拉开车门致欢迎词，并称呼“我”为 Miss Madden。
